title: Risikoanalyse Response
description: Answers to the six questions of chapter 3.7 Risikoanalyse A.5 (BSI Muster-Auditbericht V3.0, Tabelle 40) and a single audit finding.

answers.description: An array of 6 boolean answers, one for each question asked. The order must be preserved.

finding.description: A single, structured finding for this section.

category.description: Category of the finding: 'AG' (Minor Deviation), 'AS' (Major Deviation), 'E' (Recommendation), or 'OK'.

description.description: A clear, concise description of the finding, including evidence and document reference.
